Disabling abbreviation expansion keeps tooltip titles out of page text

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, ContentConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        content=ContentConfig(expand_abbreviations=False, extract_metadata=False),
        respect_robots_txt=False,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
